page.overview:
What is Will of D.?

The "Will of D." is a form of inherited will surrounding members of the の一族|Dī no Ichizoku|VIZ: People of the D}} who bear the initial "D." in their names.

It is said that the Clan is the and is opposed to the World Government, namely its World Nobles, though most members do not know its true meaning. Gol D. Roger, who learned its meaning during his voyage to Laugh Tale, is considered to be a central figure concerning the Will of D, with much discussion about those who have since borne the initial centering on them inheriting Roger's will. More often than not, people in the Clan of D. have been noted to be regularly involved in world-shaking events.

According to Nerona Imu, the D. was once a label used by enemies of the First Twenty, who were thus presumably aligned with the Great Kingdom. Donquixote Rosinante explained to Trafalgar D. Water Law that the "D." has been secretly inherited worldwide throughout history and that in a certain land, the Clan of D. was referred to as the "Natural Enemy of God", with "God" referring to the Celestial Dragons, who are considered to be gods. In Mary Geoise, World Noble children were told that if they misbehaved, they would be eaten up by "D". Similarly, elders of that country seemed quite wary of the "storm" that those with "D." were known to cause.

However, Imu has stated that present-day carriers of the initial usually do not know about its origins and meaning. Jaguar D. Saul displayed a lack of knowledge on the subject when Nico Robin asked him what it meant. Similarly, when Robin brought up the significance of the initial to Luffy, he was completely clueless as to what she was talking about. Luffy and Ace themselves never thought much about their names during their childhood, in spite of Sabo pointing out the obvious coincidence. Gol D. Roger is the first and, as of yet, only known "D."-bearer in the modern era storyline to have discovered its meaning.
